docker-compose.description: The catalog's compose files are named <id>.compose.yml, which Renovate's default docker-compose pattern does not match -- it wants docker-compose*.y*ml or compose*.y*ml. The only files in this repo that DO match are the generated blueprints/<id>/docker-compose.yml copies, and those are in ignorePaths, so the manager ran over nothing: 23 compose files, zero dependencies extracted, and not one catalog image was ever proposed for a bump. Every packageRule below that matches docker-compose was dead config until this pattern existed. Pointed at sources/ because that is canonical; blueprints/ stays ignored, or each image would be tracked twice.

packageRules.description: Traefik feature-set + config schema owned by the catena operator role (roles/traefik); minor/major land via operator converge, not catalog edits.

Postgres is centrally governed: the per-template compose pins must equal postgres_default_image in sources/_meta.json (build/lint_postgres_pins.py fails the build otherwise). Group EVERY postgres bump -- the docker-compose pins AND the central-default customManager below -- into one reviewed PR so they move together and the lint stays green. A split bump (pins without the default, or vice versa) reddens the PR, which is what happened while the docker-compose manager matched no files: the customManager moved _meta.json alone and the lint named all eleven unmoved pins. automerge off: a Postgres major/minor is a coordinated, reviewed change.

customManagers.description: Track the central Postgres image (postgres_default_image) in sources/_meta.json. The per-template compose pins follow it (enforced by build/lint_postgres_pins.py); the packageRule above groups this bump with the compose-pin bumps into one PR. Note that _meta.json is a SOURCE file, so a bump here leaves catalog.json and the other rendered artifacts behind and the render-idempotency job fails until `make render` runs -- the same is true of any compose-pin bump.
